textEntity.title: Text Entity
textEntity.description: The Entity that has the text Element to update with the inputted text.

inputType.title: Input Type
inputType.description: What type of input will this field accept. On some devices, the virtual keyboard layout may change as well. For example, 'Number' will bring up a numpad instead of the full keyboard.

enterKeyHint.title: Enter Key Hint
enterKeyHint.description: Change what the enter key shows on the virutal keyboard. Different OSs will have different representations of the hint.

maxLength.title: Max Length
maxLength.description: Maximum length of the text can be.

placeHolder.title: Place Holder String
placeHolder.description: When the inputted text is empty, what should show as placeholder? Usually this is a prompt such as 'Enter your email here'.

placeHolderColor.title: Place Holder Text Color
placeHolderColor.description: What color the text should be when the placeholder string is used.

speedMultiplier.description: Speed of player and speed of opponent * multiplySpeed. Make it 0.5 to make speed of both x2 times slower or 2 to make it faster

coinsForAd.description: The amount of coins player needs to open box by watching ad

boatOceanX.title: Boat Ocean X
boatOceanX.description: X position threshold where open ocean begins and the boat drops to surface.

boatSurfaceY.title: Boat Surface Y
boatSurfaceY.description: Target Y height the boat settles at on open ocean.

boatSinkDeathY.title: Boat Sink Death Y
boatSinkDeathY.description: Y below which the boat is considered sunk and the run ends.

boatSinkSpeed.title: Boat Sink Speed
boatSinkSpeed.description: Lerp factor controlling how quickly the boat settles onto the ocean surface.

boatRockAmplitude.title: Boat Rock Amplitude
boatRockAmplitude.description: Max roll angle (degrees) of the side-to-side rocking on the ocean.

boatRockSpeed.title: Boat Rock Speed
boatRockSpeed.description: Oscillation speed of the rocking effect (radians per second).

defaultItems.description: Default items to initialize inventory with

selectedSlotColor.description: Color for the selected/active slot background

highlightColor.description: Color for highlighting drop targets during drag

dragHoverColor.description: Color for slot hover state during drag

slotSelectedForSwapColor.description: Color for slots selected for swapping (orange highlight)

hideInFlightMode.description: Hide hotbar when flying the plane (Vehicle:Start active)

slotTemplate.description: Template slot entity to clone for creating hotbar slots

maxSlots.description: Maximum number of hotbar slots to create

enableMobileButtons.description: Enable button component click handling for mobile touch support

removalModeColor.description: Background color for slots when in removal mode

enableKeyboardInput.description: Enable keyboard number keys (1-9) for slot selection

enableMobileTouch.description: Enable touch input for mobile devices

enableScrollWheel.description: Enable mouse scroll wheel for slot selection

keyBindings.description: Key bindings for hotbar slots (keyCode -> slotIndex)

offsetY.title: Y Offset
offsetY.description: Optional Y offset to apply to the sky position

followX.title: Follow X
followX.description: Whether to follow player on X axis

followZ.title: Follow Z
followZ.description: Whether to follow player on Z axis

promptText.description: Text to display on the interaction prompt

promptOffset.description: Offset position for the UI prompt above the seat

eventName.description: Event to fire when seat is interacted with

sendEntity.description: Whether to send the seat entity with the event

isLevelEnd.description: Is this the last checkpoint of the level?

interactionKey.description: Key to press for seat interaction

vehiclePlane.description: Reference to the vehicle plane entity

promptOffset.description: Offset position for the UI prompt above the nearest seat

playerEntity.title: Player Entity
playerEntity.description: The player entity that will collide with rings

collisionLayer.title: Collision Layer
collisionLayer.description: Physics layer for collisions (entities on same layer can collide)

ringTag.title: Ring Tag
ringTag.description: Tag used to identify ring entities

useExistingCollisions.title: Use Existing Collisions
useExistingCollisions.description: Use existing collision components instead of creating new ones

useDistanceDetection.title: Use Distance Detection
useDistanceDetection.description: Use distance-based detection instead of physics triggers (for kinematic vehicles)

adIcon.description: The ad icon entity to show/hide

skinName.description: The name of the skin for the event

captureCamera.description: Camera entity for capturing plane images

vehiclePlane.description: Reference to the vehicle plane entity
